stage: BASE Phase20 outcome-aware state-role curriculum and zero-update gate
hypothesis: A currently safe prefix from a height-failure episode can be labeled as a critical reset state when height collapse occurs 0.5-1.5 seconds later, without pretending that the complete episode was critical or treating its actions as expert labels.
intervention: Build an immutable source-reference-only manifest from Phase19 v2 success and height-failure sidecars, then inject fixed 16-env batches for success_safe and critical_from_failure at zero PPO/optimizer updates.
control: fraction=0 returns before manifest I/O or RNG; zero-update probes use identical Isaac sole12, 50 Hz, seed 47, no observation corruption and no external perturbation.

zero_update_probe.sensor_gait_override_boundary: reset-return only; exact saved base velocity, torso IMU angular/gravity and gait/contact values expire after the first simulator step

result: Both state roles are non-empty and both fixed 16-env zero-update batches reconstruct physical state, 93D, action history, command, clock, controller state and actor source within the preregistered tolerances.
conclusion: Phase20 passes the data/schema and zero-update injection gates. It does not prove that the candidate will improve closed-loop recovery; it only permits a single paired five-update experiment for review.

five_update_preregistration.candidate_sampling: sample state role 1:1, then uniformly sample one eligible row within that role
five_update_preregistration.failure_actions: history/state only; no behavior cloning, imitation loss, or expert label
five_update_preregistration.training_domain: ideal, sole12, self-collision off, official ankle PD, 50 Hz
five_update_preregistration.paired_freeze: same source, optimizer reset semantics, minibatches, seed, manifest hash, reward, observation/action contract and evaluation contract; only fraction and output label differ
five_update_preregistration.post_train_evaluation: source/fraction0/fraction0.05 each receive five frozen official matched-event episodes with Stage306 moving actor and the same adapter/control hashes
five_update_preregistration.promotion: candidate full-gate count is not below source or fraction0 and moves stiff-fixed recovery toward 5/5, with no startup/move/stop regression or actor/interface mismatch
five_update_preregistration.abort: any non-exact reset field, invalid official episode, candidate regression, or failure to improve recovery stops at five updates; 25-update remains locked

boundaries: critical_from_failure is a state role, not an independently observed critical episode outcome.
Exact observation overrides are valid only for reset-return and expire after the first simulator step.
Official/Isaac simulation evidence is not real X2 hardware or real foot-force truth.
No training, WBT, real robot, Git or cloud backup was run in Phase20.
